purpose: Task-local source re-attestation for the M1 product-manager review.

facts.fact: V2 validates one exact Codex thread UUID, persists it in state, and serializes atomic claim creation or terminal handoff by stable claim key.
UI serialization is derived from the complete browser/profile/tab/session identity instead of one process-wide mutex.
The V2 send path proves the DOM URL under the target mutex, claims that proved target before global reservation or mutation, then preserves no-resend state across acknowledgement uncertainty.
Wait validates thread and claim ownership before browser work and holds the target mutex only around each observation.
RootWait forwards the exact Codex thread identity to status, send, and finalization adapter calls.
run-root accepts either no explicit target or the complete browser/profile/tab/session tuple and rejects a partial tuple before adapter invocation.
The CCG bridge source is unchanged at M1; its atomic session and canonical evidence work remains scoped to M2.
